subject: Q2 bookings vs target — mismatch & remediation playbook
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 bookings vs target — quick health check

Diego / Monica —

Finance flagged a material mismatch between the bookings we have in forecast and the commit figure used for the board cash planning. The attached snapshot shows a ~22% shortfall vs the target we agreed for Q2 when we last aligned. I need a concise remediation playbook by EOD tomorrow.

Please include:
- Top 5 deals driving the delta (GAAP expected close date + stage + ARR impact)
- Which deals we believe can be pulled into commit and why (evidence: customer signals, PO timing, procurement blockers)
- Any controllable actions (discounts, PO escalation, CS involvement, exec intro) and owners
- Worst-case and best-case $ impact by week for the remainder of the quarter

Keep it tight — this will go to finance and to the CRO for a morning sync on Thursday. Mark any super-high-risk deals for immediate exec attention.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q2_booking_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet, 18KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sara Hales <sara.hales@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 bookings vs target — quick health check

Lauren —

Thanks for the ping. I dug into our pipeline and prepared a short summary + a working attachments pack (see acme_updated_solution_scope.pdf). High level:

Top contributors to the delta (rough ARR):
- Acme Analytics — $480k (was in late opportunity, PO cadence slipped; strong product evals; legal reviewing T&Cs)
- Suncrest Media — $320k (decision moved to next quarter, procurement requires SOC2 evidence)
- Finexus — $200k (procurement queue; procurement wants annual invoicing)
- LumenRetail — $150k (pilot success, exec signoff pending)
- Norstar Labs — $90k (pricing negotiation)

Why Acme can move: customer has completed two POCs and committed to an SOW draft (attached). They indicated preferred start in June but procurement asked for legal clarifications. They also asked for a short data residency note — I proposed an exec-ops call with their VP of Data to speed approvals.

Immediate actions I recommend (owners):
- Diego: schedule exec-ops call with Acme (target: 48 hours)
- Monica: assemble SOC2 evidence pack and send to Suncrest procurement (target: 24 hours)
- Monica + RevOps: confirm Finexus invoicing cadence options and propose monthly plan to unblock PO (target: 48 hours)
- Diego + AE: prep 1-page one-pager for LumenRetail execs focusing on ROI by month 1 (target: 72 hours)

Scenario impact (remaining 6 weeks):
- Best case (all 5 move): +$1.24M (covers +3% buffer)
- Base case (Acme + Suncrest close): +$800k (reduces shortfall to ~9%)
- Worst case (none close): no change to current shortfall (-22%)

I attached the Acme SOW draft and an annotated row for each deal in the sheet. Planning to lock stage updates tonight and will push a refreshed snapshot by EOD tomorrow.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_updated_solution_scope.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

> On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 09:12, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Diego / Monica —
> > 
> > Finance flagged a material mismatch... (see original)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 bookings vs target — quick health check

Thanks Diego — nice summary. A couple of clarifications after I reconciled the CRM snapshots vs billing pipeline:

1) Stage mismatch: two opportunities (Finexus and Norstar) are still in "Proposal" but were credit-approved and expected to convert. Finance had them in commit in the last close; they were moved back to best-case after the AE noted invoicing constraints. I recommend we reclassify Finexus to commit conditional on monthly invoicing (I have a billing note that they'd accept monthly invoices).

2) Evidence pack status: SOC2 artifacts for Suncrest are ready; I will send the full package to their procurement by EOD and copy RevOps.

3) Risk adjustment: I agree with the scenario buckets but suggest adding a "probability-weighted" column for each deal; that will make the forecast delta clearer for the board. I sketched probabilities in column H of the sheet.

Action owners updated:
- Monica: Send SOC2 pack to Suncrest (done) + confirm Finexus invoicing terms (in progress)
- Diego: Exec-ops for Acme (please include Lauren and AE in the invite)
- Lauren: Confirm whether Finance will accept a conditional commit note for Finexus (i.e., commit if monthly invoices accepted)

I also flagged Norstar as a low-dollar risk but high SLAs sensitivity — support needs to confirm delivery timeline if pricing concessions are given.

Monica Patel
Senior RevOps Analyst
Redwood Inference

> On Tue, May 11, 2027 at 11:03, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Lauren —
> > 
> > Thanks for the ping. I dug into our pipeline...

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: CRO <cfo.cro@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 bookings vs target — quick health check

Great work — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. A few decisions and next steps:

1) Diego: lock Acme as "commit-probable" with the exec-ops cadence and get a calendar invite to their VP + our CRO. We need the PO timing confirmation on the call.
2) Monica: push SOC2 pack to Suncrest now and mark the opportunity "commit" if procurement confirms receipt.
3) Finance decision: I spoke to finance — they will accept a conditional commit notation for Finexus (commit if monthly invoicing confirmed). Monica, loop me when Finexus agrees to monthly terms.
4) Weekly cadence: Diego, add this deal set to the Wed revenue rollup for the quarter and include the probability-weighted column in the deck.

I'll assemble a short one-pager for the executive sync on Thursday morning using your numbers. If the best-case holds, we cover the shortfall; if not, we'll bring pricing levers to the table.

Please confirm when the calendar invite with Acme is sent; cc me so I can join.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Q2_booking_snapshot.xlsx (revised)
